2026-09-03ECCCImpact Assessment ActRegulations Amending the Physical Activities RegulationsRegulations Amending the Physical Activities Regulations in order to remove the following project types from the Regulations which will no longer be subject to the Act: international and interprovincial pipelines; international and interprovincial electrical transmission lines; offshore renewable energy projects that are regulated under the Canadian Energy Regulator Act (CERA); oil and gas pipelines and facilities in national parks and protected areas that are regulated under CERA; oil and gas facilities that are functionally integrated into a federal work or undertaking that are regulated under the CERA; in situ oil sands extraction facilities with a bitumen production capacity of 2 000 m3/day or more; in a province without provincial legislation to limit greenhouse gas emissions from oil sands; and fossil fuel-fired power generating facilities.Registration: SOR/2026-0185 Publication Date: 2026-09-09
subject: Regulations Amending the Physical Activities Regulations
precis: Regulations Amending the Physical Activities Regulations in order to remove the following project types from the Regulations which will no longer be subject to the Act: international and interprovincial pipelines; international and interprovincial electrical transmission lines; offshore renewable energy projects that are regulated under the Canadian Energy Regulator Act (CERA); oil and gas pipelines and facilities in national parks and protected areas that are regulated under CERA; oil and gas facilities that are functionally integrated into a federal work or undertaking that are regulated under the CERA; in situ oil sands extraction facilities with a bitumen production capacity of 2 000 m3/day or more; in a province without provincial legislation to limit greenhouse gas emissions from oil sands; and fossil fuel-fired power generating facilities.
